Summary: REG-01: Homepage loads with default listing of all cars
Description:
URL: https://carsforsell.ddev.site/

Preconditions: Site is running; 10 published car listings exist.

Steps:
1. Open https://carsforsell.ddev.site/ as an anonymous user.

Expected result:
- Page title is 'Cars for sale | Cars for Sale' and H1 'Cars for sale' is shown.
- Result count shows '10 cars found'.
- 10 car cards are shown, sorted by 'Newest listings' (default).
- Each card shows title, price, location, year, mileage, fuel type, transmission, a '2 photos' link and a 'View & buy' link.

Summary: REG-02: Keyword search by make/model returns matching cars
Description:
URL: https://carsforsell.ddev.site/

Steps:
1. Type 'Toyota' into the Search box (placeholder 'Make, model or keyword').
2. Click Search.
3. Repeat with 'Miata' and with a keyword that matches nothing (e.g. 'Lamborghini').

Expected result:
- 'Toyota' returns only the 2021 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid XLE and 2022 Toyota Camry SE; count shows '2 cars found'.
- 'Miata' returns only the 2018 Mazda MX-5 Miata Club.
- A keyword with no match shows 0 results and a friendly empty-results message, with no errors.

Summary: REG-09: Car card links open the correct listing and purchase flow
Description:
URL: https://carsforsell.ddev.site/

Steps:
1. For one car (e.g. 2020 Subaru Outback Premium), click the car title.
2. Go back and click '2 photos'.
3. Go back and click 'View & buy'.
4. Repeat a quick check on at least two other cards.

Expected result:
- Title link opens the detail page for that exact car (same title, price, location, specs as the card).
- '2 photos' opens the photo gallery for that car with 2 images loaded (no broken images).
- 'View & buy' opens the detail/purchase page for that car with a visible buy/enquiry action.
- No 404 or access-denied errors for anonymous users.

Summary: REG-10: Header navigation, login link, sticky header and accessibility
Description:
URL: https://carsforsell.ddev.site/

Steps:
1. Click the site name 'Cars for Sale', then 'Browse cars', then 'Home'.
2. Click 'Log in'.
3. Turn the 'Sticky header' switch on and scroll down, then turn it off and scroll again.
4. Press Tab from the top of the page.
5. Repeat steps 1 and 3 at mobile width (375px).

Expected result:
- Site name, Browse cars and Home all lead to the car listing page without errors.
- Log in opens the Drupal /user/login form.
- With sticky header on, the header stays visible while scrolling; with it off, it scrolls away.
- The first Tab press shows a working 'Skip to main content' link; all filter fields have labels and can be reached by keyboard.
- The layout works on mobile with no horizontal scrolling, and filters and cards are usable.
